TINGNAN: Iba’t ibang grupo ng mga medical students at health workers ang nagsagawa ng human chain against corruption protest sa kahabaan ng E. Rodriguez Sr. Ave., Quezon City, partikular sa tapat ng National Children’s Hospital ngayong Biyernes, Nov. 21. | via Charmaine Abong

#DWAR1494

Hundreds of fisherfolk from the Pambansang Lakas ng Kilusang Mamamalakaya ng Pilipinas (PAMALAKAYA), along with coastal residents from Zambales and Ilocos Sur, marched to the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) headquarters in Quezon City on Friday, November 21, to mark World Fisheries Day and demand accountability for what they said were destructive quarrying and reclamation activities harming the country’s marine and aquatic resources.

The protesters also denounced “corruption-tainted” flood-control and infrastructure projects, saying these have weakened coastal communities’ climate resilience and increased their vulnerability to flooding. 

📸: Santi San Juan/MB
